author: AShadowRogue
quote: Visually impressive. But the low and choppy frame rate immediately makes you wish for worse visuals and better performance.  The story is the real issue here though. It's slow, boring, and makes you feel like you have to grind the game just to get to any moment of enjoyment and freedom. The player characters are just as boring, and their relationship is tedious to play and listen to. Gone are the days of Trevor, Franklin, and Michael, and it's for the much worse.
